ends.note: 60 ft Valley Street stops at the railroad right-of-way north of Harrison; only a 10 ft unnamed passage (x 2465-2497) continues south to Harrison, so no Valley/Harrison junction is recorded

notes: 1922 vol 1 plate 13, left half. Gutter overlap with 22-13R: Turner Street lies on the extreme right edge of this half (its west line is drawn at x~5997-6009, its centreline falls at x~6025-6029, 1-5 px beyond the last pixel), so Harrison/Turner, Acorn Alley/Turner and Coppin Street/Turner are recorded at x=6024 (clamped to the edge; true centre a few px further right); the same three are picked on 22-13R. Turner/Bank is off this half. Names: only 'AVENUE' is printed for Queen City Avenue and nothing for Bank Street on this half; both names are taken from the 1904 sheets (233/234, 222-224). 'ACORN AL.' = Acorn Alley (the 1904 Harvis Alley position, east of Spring Grove opposite Ernst Alley, ~56 px apart, both T). Coppin Street (20 ft, 'COPPIN ... STREET') is the 1904 20 ft 'Ernst Alley' of sheet 224 that ran east to Turner/Winchell; the 1922 Ernst Alley (10 ft, printed 'ERNST ALLEY') runs from Buck to Spring Grove west of Spring Grove. Turner Alley (1904) is printed Turner Street. No bracketed old names were seen on this half. Buck Street jogs at Harrison (south part 50 ft centred x~4376, north part 40 ft centred x~4566) and Spring Grove jogs at Harrison (north part centred x~5253, south part x~5317): each recorded as two T points, with the part named in brackets. Lowry Street is a market-space street: island block between two ~30 ft roadways; the north roadway carries the LOWRY ST. label, the south roadway is unnamed ('?', recorded at Western and Barnard), as on 1904 sheet 223. '?' crossing Ernst Alley = unnamed ~16 ft N-S alley from Harrison to Barnard at x~4840. Spring Grove Avenue: at (5323,5929) the avenue splits: the labelled SPRING GROVE AVE. runs diagonally SW to the Western Avenue junction, where it becomes McLean Avenue (100 ft); the straight 50 ft strip continuing south to Bank (east of the triangle block, 1904 'Division Street') is unlabelled here, recorded as '?' at the split point and at Bank; its east-side addresses 2100-2136 continue the Spring Grove numbering. Barnard Street ends at the diagonal Spring Grove. Spring Grove/Western and McLean/Western share one point (Western crosses; Spring Grove becomes McLean there); Western jogs slightly at that junction. McRoberts Street (40 ft) runs from Duck across Dolph to Western. Dolph Street: 'DOLPH' printed north of McRoberts and 'STREET' south of it; same straight line from the viaduct strip to Bank (building 12 sits at the Dolph/Bank mouth). Garrard/Bank is T because Bank is not drawn west of Garrard (the scale bar lies in the street area there); Garrard continues south. McLean and Western continue south of Bank (openings in the south line), so those are crosses. The trolley viaduct crossing from Harrison near Barnard southwest over Western and Garrard is not a street. Old canal bed, railroads and the Mill Creek yard tracks ignored.
